Thames Rovers beat Lombardia Nord 1-0. On expected goals it finished 0.00–0.00: neither side managed a shot, so the defences won the day.

Lombardia Nord had 61% of the ball. Pass completion LOM 83% (186/224), TRV 68% (91/133). Shots 0–0, on target 0–0.

Lombardia Nord started in a 3-5-2 (possession), Thames Rovers in a 4-3-3 (balanced). In-game changes: LOM to 3-4-3 at 88' (chasing the game); TRV to 5-4-1 at 88' (protecting the lead).

Turning point, 87': An own goal by C. Torilito Score now LOM 0-1 TRV. It proved to be the winner.

By the numbers: R. Laucourt completed the most passes (36); J. Namlagu hit the top speed (32 km/h); N. Engoberg covered the most ground (5.95 km, a 17.1 km per-90 pace); G. Zorlav won the most challenges (14).

recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Lombarda, Milan. An own goal opened the scoring in the 87th minute, and Thames Rovers were ahead. Lombardia Nord pushed for a way back, switching to a 3-4-3 in the 88th minute, but Thames Rovers held firm. The hero: G. Zorlav, with 8 completed passes and 14 tackles. At the final whistle, Thames Rovers celebrate in front of their fans.
